title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go and bump SDK versions to v1.49.0
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: SDK surface across Python/TypeScript/Go has diverged in auth middleware, retry/backoff configuration, and streaming ergonomics. This causes behavioural differences for customers using multi-language integrations and complicates internal docs and support.

Summary: This PR aligns auth handling and retry semantics across the three official SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics so typing and cancellation are consistent, and performs a coordinated version bump to v1.49.0. Changes are implemented with backwards-compatible adapters where necessary and include updated examples and test coverage.

What changed (high level):
- Unified auth pipeline: centralize token refresh + header injection logic; standardize error propagation for auth failures across SDKs.
- Retry changes: expose a RetryConfig (max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, jitter, retriable_statuses) with consistent default values and exponential backoff implementation parity.
- Streaming ergonomics: make streaming response iterators/callbacks mirror each other (async iterator in Python/TS, channel-based & context-aware reader in Go), add clear cancellation/close semantics and a small helper to collect partial events.
- Parity & ergonomics: minor API name changes (aliases kept for one release) and doc updates so examples look identical across languages.
- Version bumps: python/ts/go packages -> v1.49.0, updated changelogs and package metadata.

Compatibility notes:
- Default retry behavior changed to be more conservative (fewer immediate retries on 429/5xx). Existing callers relying on the previous aggressive retry may opt into the legacy behavior via the compatibility flag: LegacyRetryBehavior=true for one release.
- Public API aliases retained (deprecated) for convenience; deprecation warnings logged at runtime.

Testing & CI: Unit + integration tests added for retry windows, streaming cancellation, and auth refresh edge-cases. Cross-language smoke tests were run in the perf lab. CI: build/test/lint across all SDKs; a flaky TS streaming E2E test was rerun and passed on attempt 2.

Release notes: See release_notes field.

References: ENG-1345 (unify SDK retry surface), ENG-1400 (streaming ergonomics), PM-201 (release coordination), SUP-879 (customer-reported auth refresh edge-case).

merge_details: Squash merged by Elena Garcia after approvals from Sam Liu and Marcus Reed. All CI checks passing at merge time. Coordinated package publication pushed by release bot with tags: sdk-python/v1.49.0, sdk-typescript/v1.49.0, sdk-go/v1.49.0.
release_notes:
- Unified auth and retry surface across SDKs (python/typescript/go).
- Streaming API ergonomics improved and cancellation semantics standardized.
- New RetryConfig exposed with conservative defaults.
- Backwards-compatible aliases retained for one release.
- SDKs bumped to v1.49.0.
notes_for_backport: No backport needed; changes are SDK-only. If backporting to release/* for critical customer hotfixes, prefer cherry-pick of auth refresh fix only (go commit f2d1c4).
test_summary: Added 12 unit tests and 3 integration tests across SDKs. Cross-language smoke tests executed in perf-lab and a flaky TS e2e test required a rerun but passed. All new tests included in CI.
acknowledgements: Thanks to the SDK working group (Sam, Elena, Marcus) and QE for e2e validation.
migration_guidance: Short migration guidance included in sdks/common/migration_guide_v1.49.0.md; main steps: adopt new RetryConfig or set LegacyRetryBehavior=true, update streaming examples to use the new helpers, watch for deprecation warnings during the next release cycle.
